relations.text: Oracle NetSuiteなどとの新たな提携で、提携先の顧客がBILLの機能を利用できる
relations.text_en: Its partnership with Oracle NetSuite, among others, lets partners' customers use the BILL platform's capabilities

source.quote: Our recently-announced partnerships with Paychex, Oracle NetSuite, and Acumatica exemplify this approach, as each of these partners' customers are able to utilize some or all of our platform's capabilities.

relations.text: 「Embed 2.0」の一環として、Oracle NetSuiteなどとの組み込み提携を開始した

source.quote: In addition, we launched embed partnerships with Paychex, Oracle NetSuite, and Acumatica as part of our "Embed 2.0" initiative to deploy our platform offerings as a set of embeddable capabilities through third-party platforms.

relations.text: BILLは、Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Centralなどの会計ソフトと連携している
relations.text_en: BILL is integrated with accounting software including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

source.label: BILL 10-K
source.quote: We are integrated with several of the most popular business accounting software applications, including QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

relations.text: BILLのプラットフォームは、Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Centralの提供するAPIを通じて連携している

source.quote: To deliver a comprehensive solution, our platform integrates with popular software solutions including Intuit QuickBooks, Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, through APIs made available by these software providers.

source.label: BILL 10-K
source.quote: Through card issuing partners, BILL provides both physical and virtual Mastercard and Visa charge cards to companies that enroll in its business spend and expense management program.

relations.text: カードプログラム管理者として、Mastercardなどの規則の順守が契約上求められている

source.label: BILL 10-K
source.quote: We are contractually obligated to comply with consumer protection laws and regulations applicable to our product offerings and customer base, as well as with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express rules, as a card program manager for our card product offerings.
